name: Wakeheart Vortex
introDiscord:
Every ancient current in Leviathan's Wake seems to bend toward one
place.

Wakeheart Vortex.

The graveyard has no living heart.

The water behaves as if it does.
introTwitch:
Every ancient current in Leviathan's Wake seems to bend toward one
place.

Wakeheart Vortex.

The graveyard has no living heart.

The water behaves as if it does.

wakeheart-vortex-approach.prompt: Three currents spiral toward the center.

left.message:
A calm pocket exists impossibly close to the vortex.

Shizuki wrote:

'Everything here flows in rhythm.

Like heartbeat.

Not calling it heartbeat.

Absolutely not.'

right.message: A Wakeheart Elemental forms from the spiraling current.

forward.message: A navigator's chest circles the vortex.

left.message:
One Berry is tied to Shizuki's observation marker:

'Current pulse:
regular.

Glimmer says heartbeat.

I said no.

Glimmer keeps chiming in time.

This is bullying.'

right.message: A strongbox spins inside an eddy.

forward.message: A Wakeheart Elemental rises from the current.

wakeheart-vortex-threshold.prompt: Endless Current Core pulses beyond three paths.

left.message: An Elemental forms with each rhythmic surge.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Still not heartbeat.

Probably.

Maybe.

I dislike this entry.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicine and the argument unresolved.

forward.message: Star Candies circle the Core like tiny moons.

boss-antechamber.name: Endless Current Core
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every current in Leviathan's Wake seems to pause.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every current in Leviathan's Wake seems to pause.

Then:

one pulse.

Another.

The entire graveyard answers.

Something enormous forms at the center of the water itself.

Use /yes to enter Endless Current Core or /no to leave the Wake's
'definitely not heartbeat' unexplained.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every current in Leviathan's Wake seems to pause.

Then:

one pulse.

Another.

The entire graveyard answers.

Something enormous forms at the center of the water itself.

Use !yes to enter Endless Current Core or !no to leave the Wake's
'definitely not heartbeat' unexplained.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw.

The distant rhythm continues.

boss.revealText:
Ancient wake currents twist into a towering living form.

Heart of the Wake reveals itself!

completionText:
The Heart disperses.

The currents continue flowing along routes carved by Leviathans that
have been dead for ages.

No heartbeat.

Shizuki wins.

Technically.
